summary: At most Frobenii the characteristic polynomial of x.galRep(φ) is close to ιℓ of the Hecke polynomial H; H is divisible by the string ∏(X − ν q^i) (isRoot_hecke_string), H = string·T; comparing with S·∏(X − cycInv^i) modulo the maximal ideal and applying exists_integral_multiple_eval_one gives e.

steps.claim: Restrict to most Frobenius data (w, A, φ) at which the characteristic polynomial of x.galRep(φ) is within 1/2 of ιℓ of the Hecke polynomial at w (Attached), f is an eigenform with Hecke polynomial at w, and w is not above ℓ.
steps.lean:
filter_upwards [(x.attached_galRep hf h₀).2.2.2 _ one_half_pos, eventually_mostFrobenii
    ((x.isEigenform hf h₀).2.and (eventually_notMem_star_notMem ℓ ∅))] with w a ⟨k, _, _, l⟩ _ b e

steps.claim: The Hecke polynomial H of x at w is divisible by ∏_{i<|n|−|r|}(X − ν_w q_w^i) (pairwise coprime linear factors, each a root by isRoot_hecke_string; chiOneInv at the Frobenius: chiOneInv_spec), H = string·T; exists_integral_multiple_eval_one applied to A = chiOneInv^{|n|}·ιℓ(T), B the monic product, C the characteristic polynomial of u(φ) (integral, z), and A' = S gives e, and the root string follows by mapping back with ιℓ⁻¹; it remains that A·B ≡ C.
steps.lean:
refine (Finset.prod_dvd_of_coprime ((pairwise_coprime_X_sub_C (pow_right_strictMono₀ (by
    simp)).injective).set_pairwise _)
    (by simpa [chiOneInv_spec w.isPlaceOver l 1, w.isFrob, ↓dvd_iff_isRoot] using (fun
    _ ↦ isRoot_hecke_string hf h₀ h l (k w.prime_q).2))).elim fun T y ↦
    (exists_integral_multiple_eval_one (A := chiOneInv O w.frob ^ card n • 1 * T.map ιℓ)
    (monic_prod_X_sub_C ..) (z _) (fun i ↦ ?_) e b).imp fun _ : (intQpBar ℓ)[X] ↦ .imp_left (⟨T,
    y, by simpa [Polynomial.map_map] using! map_dvd (mapEquiv ιℓ.symm) <| dvd_of_mul_left_dvd ·⟩)

steps.claim: Write H for the Hecke polynomial at w.

A·B ≡ C coefficientwise: the coefficients of the characteristic polynomial of u(φ) = chiOneInv(φ)·x.galRep(φ) are those of x.galRep(φ) scaled by powers of chiOneInv(φ) (charpoly_smul_coeff), which is a unit (continuous avatar), and those are within 1/2 < 1 of ιℓ(H) = ιℓ(string·T), with cycInv(φ) = q_w (cycInv_eq_of_isFrob); coefficients beyond the degree vanish.
steps.lean:
by_cases! i ≤ card n <;> simpa [‹_›, cycInv_eq_of_isFrob w l, pow_sub₀, Units.smul_def, ← mul_sub,
    ← by simpa [Polynomial.map_prod, mul_comm _ T] using congr(mapEquiv ιℓ $y), norm_sub_rev,
    charpoly_smul_coeff, coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt, mul_assoc, mul_comm (ιℓ _),
    norm_eq_one_of_continuous, AlgHeckeChar.continuous_avatar] using
    (a _ rfl i).trans_lt one_half_lt_one
